text:
ana: rolled prefetch-scheduler v3 to prod for hosted + dedicated this morning. early signals look positive.

ana: quick headline numbers (prod mix): p50 -11% (70ms->62ms), p95 -16% (320ms->270ms), cost /1M tokens -20%, throughput +8% tokens/sec/GPU.

deploy-bot: canary started 2398759000, promoted 2398762000 — health checks ok across regions. :white_check_mark:

mike: nice. any sign of worse tails (p99/p999) for long-context workloads?

ana: p99 stable, p999 no change. heavy-seq tests showed small p99 improvements due to microbatch packing.

kevin: KV cache churn? we were worried prefetch could increase evictions.

ana: slot evict rate down ~5% after coalescer tweak and ttl windowing. less redundant prefetching.

liz: monitoring: error rates steady, throttles slightly lower, no new pagers.

sarah: product: let's prepare a short release note and AM one-pager. legal wants benchmark artifacts attached before external comms.

ana: uploading harness + traces to RT-4400 in ~20m.

mike: i'll run stress-run on heavy-seq harness and post results.

ana: next steps: publish release note, 2-week watch window for regressions, add dashboard panels for prefetch hit/evict, and provide artifacts for legal. thanks team! :rocket:
